description: In honor of our 70th anniversary within the tactical, survival, and professional industries, we’ve created the 1953 Embroidered Every Day Hoodie. This hooded sweatshirt features Rothco’s exclusive embroidered designs on the front and sleeves. These branded sweatshirts are an absolute game changer, giving you the freedom to comfortably work, play, or lounge from the get-go. Without a doubt, this hooded sweatshirt will become part of your go-to wardrobe. They are great for working outside, chilling around the campfire, traveling around, and other various activities! Pullover Warmth & Utility: With a warm inner fleece and super soft feel that doesn’t go away after multiple washes, these pullover hooded sweatshirts provide all-day comfort and style. The insulating double-layer drawstring hood keeps your head and neck warm, while protecting against cold wind and rain. The large front kangaroo pocket provides ample storage space and is great for warming your hands. Move Around Freely: These graphic hoodies feature active stretch side panels that enhance your field of motion, providing you with increased mobility. The elastic ribbed knit cuffs and waist conform to your body without restricting your movement. These pullover hoodie sweatshirts come with a tag-less neck label for added convenience and comfort. Tough and Durable Construction: We didn’t invent the hoodie, but we did perfect it with a warm and comfortable 8.3 oz. cotton blend composition that you’ll never want to take off. These hoodie sweatshirts are designed for every day wear, and can be worn in a variety of environments. Perfect Fit for Everyone: These dependably warm pullover hoodie sweatshirts are a great fit for anyone. This is the one hooded sweatshirt you’ll want to keep nearby, and perhaps keep an extra, just in case.
